title: Uruguayan Smoked Beef Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish with a gluten-free twist. Smoked beef empanadas are a delicious and savory pastry filled with tender beef.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a pan, heat some olive oil and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the smoked beef to the pan and cook until heated through.
Place a spoonful of the beef mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with a little water and fold the other half of the dough over the filling.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little olive oil and cut a few slits in the top of each.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
